```{r}
#| context: setup
#| include: false

library(shiny)
library(tidyverse)
library(tabulapdf)
library(DT)

neuro2_available <- requireNamespace("neuro2", quietly = TRUE)
if (neuro2_available) {
  library(neuro2)
}

options(shiny.maxRequestSize = 50 * 1024^2)

col_order <- c(
  "scale",
  "raw_score",
  "score",
  "percentile",
  "range",
  "ci_95",
  "test",
  "test_name",
  "domain",
  "subdomain",
  "narrow",
  "pass",
  "verbal",
  "timed",
  "test_type",
  "score_type",
  "absort",
  "description",
  "result"
)

# Complete metadata
meta <- tribble(
  ~scale                                       , ~domain                , ~subdomain                , ~narrow                            , ~pass        , ~verbal  , ~timed    , ~test_type           , ~score_type      , ~absort                                                    , ~description                                                     ,
  "Trial 1 Correct"                            , "Memory"               , "Learning Efficiency"     , "Word-List Learning"               , "Sequential" , "Verbal" , "Untimed" , "npsych_test"        , "scaled_score"   , "cvlt3_brief_trial 1 correct_1"                            , "Correct number of words learned on the first trial"             ,
  "Trial 2 Correct"                            , "Memory"               , "Learning Efficiency"     , "Word-List Learning"               , "Sequential" , "Verbal" , "Untimed" , "npsych_test"        , "scaled_score"   , "cvlt3_brief_trial 2 correct_2"                            , "Correct number of words learned on the second trial"            ,
  "Trial 3 Correct"                            , "Memory"               , "Learning Efficiency"     , "Word-List Learning"               , "Sequential" , "Verbal" , "Untimed" , "npsych_test"        , "scaled_score"   , "cvlt3_brief_trial 3 correct_3"                            , "Correct number of words learned on the third trial"             ,
  "Trial 4 Correct"                            , "Memory"               , "Learning Efficiency"     , "Word-List Learning"               , "Sequential" , "Verbal" , "Untimed" , "npsych_test"        , "scaled_score"   , "cvlt3_brief_trial 4 correct_4"                            , "Correct number of words learned on the fourth trial"            ,
  "Trials 1-4 Correct"                         , "Memory"               , "Learning Efficiency"     , "Word-List Learning"               , "Sequential" , "Verbal" , "Untimed" , "npsych_test"        , "standard_score" , "cvlt3_brief_trials 1-4 correct_1"                         , "Learning and recall of rote verbal information (word list)"     ,
  "Short Delay Free Recall"                    , "Memory"               , "Delayed Recall"          , "Free-Recall Memory"               , "Sequential" , "Verbal" , "Untimed" , "npsych_test"        , "scaled_score"   , "cvlt3_brief_short delay free recall_1"                    , "Recall of the list after a short delay"                         ,
  "Long Delay Free Recall"                     , "Memory"               , "Delayed Recall"          , "Free-Recall Memory"               , "Sequential" , "Verbal" , "Untimed" , "npsych_test"        , "scaled_score"   , "cvlt3_brief_long delay free recall_2"                     , "Recall of the list after a long (20-minute) delay"              ,
  "Long Delay Cued Recall"                     , "Memory"               , "Delayed Recall"          , "Free-Recall Memory"               , "Sequential" , "Verbal" , "Untimed" , "npsych_test"        , "scaled_score"   , "cvlt3_brief_long delay cued recall_3"                     , "Recall of the list after a long (20-minute) delay with cues"    ,
  "Total Hits"                                 , "Memory"               , "Delayed Recall"          , "Recognition Memory"               , "Sequential" , "Verbal" , "Untimed" , "npsych_test"        , "scaled_score"   , "cvlt3_brief_total hits_1"                                 , "Yes/no recognition total hits"                                  ,
  "Total False Positives"                      , "Memory"               , "Delayed Recall"          , "Recognition Memory"               , "Sequential" , "Verbal" , "Untimed" , "npsych_test"        , "scaled_score"   , "cvlt3_brief_total false positives_2"                      , "Yes/no recognition total false positives"                       ,
  "Recognition Discriminability (d')"          , "Memory"               , "Delayed Recall"          , "Recognition Memory"               , "Sequential" , "Verbal" , "Untimed" , "npsych_test"        , "scaled_score"   , "cvlt3_brief_recognition discriminability (d')_3"          , "Yes/no recognition discriminability"                            ,
  "Recognition Discriminability Nonparametric" , "Memory"               , "Delayed Recall"          , "Recognition Memory"               , "Sequential" , "Verbal" , "Untimed" , "npsych_test"        , "scaled_score"   , "cvlt3_brief_recognition discriminability nonparametric_4" , "Yes/no recognition discriminability (nonparametric)"            ,
  "CVLT-3 Total Intrusions"                    , "Attention/Executive"  , "Attentional Functioning" , "Response Monitoring"              , "Attention"  , "Verbal" , "Untimed" , "npsych_test"        , "scaled_score"   , "cvlt3_brief_cvlt-3 total intrusions_1"                    , "Total number of intrusive response errors"                      ,
  "CVLT-3 Total Repetitions"                   , "Attention/Executive"  , "Attentional Functioning" , "Response Monitoring"              , "Attention"  , "Verbal" , "Untimed" , "npsych_test"        , "scaled_score"   , "cvlt3_brief_cvlt-3 total repetitions_1"                   , "Total number of repetitive response errors"                     ,
  "CVLT-3 Forced-Choice Recognition Hits"      , "Performance Validity" , "Cognitive Effort"        , "Forced-Choice Recognition Memory" , ""           , "Verbal" , "Untimed" , "validity_indicator" , "raw_score"      , "cvlt3_brief_cvlt-3 forced-choice recognition hits_1"      , "Number of hits on forced-choice recognition trials (raw score)"
)
```

## Step 1: Extract Full Pages (No Areas)

First, extract the entire page to see what tabulapdf finds.

```{r}
#| panel: sidebar

fileInput("file", "Upload CVLT-3 Brief PDF", accept = ".pdf")

hr()
h4("Step 1: Extract Pages")
numericInput("page_core", "Core Score Summary page:", value = 19, min = 1)
numericInput("page_index", "Standard Score Summary page:", value = 23, min = 1)
numericInput("page_process", "Process Score Summary page:", value = 25, min = 1)

selectInput("method", "Method:", c("stream", "lattice"), "stream")
actionButton("extract_btn", "Extract Full Pages", class = "btn-primary")

hr()
h4("Step 2: Map Rows")
helpText("After extraction, identify row numbers for each scale")

hr()
actionButton("build_btn", "Build Final CSV", class = "btn-success")
downloadButton("dl", "Download CSV")
```

```{r}
#| panel: fill

verbatimTextOutput("status")

tabsetPanel(
  tabPanel(
    "Core Page Raw",
    helpText(
      "Find rows for: Trial 1-4, Short/Long Delay, Recognition, Intrusions, Forced-Choice"
    ),
    DTOutput("core_raw")
  ),
  tabPanel(
    "Index Page Raw",
    helpText("Find row for: Trials 1-4 Correct (standard score)"),
    DTOutput("index_raw")
  ),
  tabPanel(
    "Process Page Raw",
    helpText("Find row for: Total Repetitions"),
    DTOutput("process_raw")
  ),
  tabPanel("Row Mapping", uiOutput("mapping_ui")),
  tabPanel("Final Output", DTOutput("final_tbl"))
)
```

```{r}
#| context: server

safe_num <- function(x) {
  suppressWarnings(as.numeric(gsub("[^0-9.-]", "", as.character(x))))
}

rv <- reactiveValues(core = NULL, index = NULL, process = NULL, final = NULL)

# Extract full pages
observeEvent(input$extract_btn, {
  req(input$file)

  withProgress(message = "Extracting pages...", {
    # Core page
    incProgress(0.3, detail = "Core page")
    tryCatch(
      {
        res <- tabulapdf::extract_tables(
          input$file$datapath,
          pages = input$page_core,
          method = input$method,
          output = "data.frame"
        )
        if (length(res) > 0) {
          # Combine all tables from page
          rv$core <- bind_rows(lapply(res, function(x) {
            x <- as.data.frame(x)
            x$row_num <- seq_len(nrow(x))
            x
          }))
        }
      },
      error = function(e) {
        showNotification(paste("Core error:", e$message), type = "error")
      }
    )

    # Index page
    incProgress(0.3, detail = "Index page")
    tryCatch(
      {
        res <- tabulapdf::extract_tables(
          input$file$datapath,
          pages = input$page_index,
          method = input$method,
          output = "data.frame"
        )
        if (length(res) > 0) {
          rv$index <- bind_rows(lapply(res, function(x) {
            x <- as.data.frame(x)
            x$row_num <- seq_len(nrow(x))
            x
          }))
        }
      },
      error = function(e) {
        showNotification(paste("Index error:", e$message), type = "error")
      }
    )

    # Process page
    incProgress(0.3, detail = "Process page")
    tryCatch(
      {
        res <- tabulapdf::extract_tables(
          input$file$datapath,
          pages = input$page_process,
          method = input$method,
          output = "data.frame"
        )
        if (length(res) > 0) {
          rv$process <- bind_rows(lapply(res, function(x) {
            x <- as.data.frame(x)
            x$row_num <- seq_len(nrow(x))
            x
          }))
        }
      },
      error = function(e) {
        showNotification(paste("Process error:", e$message), type = "error")
      }
    )
  })
})

output$core_raw <- renderDT({
  req(rv$core)
  datatable(
    rv$core,
    options = list(scrollX = TRUE, pageLength = 30),
    rownames = FALSE
  )
})

output$index_raw <- renderDT({
  req(rv$index)
  datatable(
    rv$index,
    options = list(scrollX = TRUE, pageLength = 20),
    rownames = FALSE
  )
})

output$process_raw <- renderDT({
  req(rv$process)
  datatable(
    rv$process,
    options = list(scrollX = TRUE, pageLength = 20),
    rownames = FALSE
  )
})

output$status <- renderText({
  core_n <- if (!is.null(rv$core)) nrow(rv$core) else 0
  idx_n <- if (!is.null(rv$index)) nrow(rv$index) else 0
  proc_n <- if (!is.null(rv$process)) nrow(rv$process) else 0
  final_n <- if (!is.null(rv$final)) nrow(rv$final) else 0
  paste0(
    "Core: ",
    core_n,
    " rows | Index: ",
    idx_n,
    " rows | Process: ",
    proc_n,
    " rows | Final: ",
    final_n,
    "/15 scales"
  )
})

# Dynamic mapping UI
output$mapping_ui <- renderUI({
  req(rv$core)

  core_cols <- setdiff(names(rv$core), "row_num")
  idx_cols <- if (!is.null(rv$index)) {
    setdiff(names(rv$index), "row_num")
  } else {
    core_cols
  }
  proc_cols <- if (!is.null(rv$process)) {
    setdiff(names(rv$process), "row_num")
  } else {
    core_cols
  }

  wellPanel(
    h4("Column Mapping"),
    fluidRow(
      column(
        3,
        selectInput(
          "col_raw",
          "Raw Score Col:",
          choices = core_cols,
          selected = core_cols[min(2, length(core_cols))]
        )
      ),
      column(
        3,
        selectInput(
          "col_score",
          "Scaled Score Col:",
          choices = core_cols,
          selected = core_cols[min(3, length(core_cols))]
        )
      ),
      column(
        3,
        selectInput(
          "col_pct",
          "Percentile Col:",
          choices = core_cols,
          selected = core_cols[min(4, length(core_cols))]
        )
      )
    ),

    hr(),
    h4("Core Page Row Numbers (check raw data tab)"),

    fluidRow(
      column(3, numericInput("r_t1", "Trial 1 row:", value = 2, min = 1)),
      column(3, numericInput("r_t2", "Trial 2 row:", value = 3, min = 1)),
      column(3, numericInput("r_t3", "Trial 3 row:", value = 4, min = 1)),
      column(3, numericInput("r_t4", "Trial 4 row:", value = 5, min = 1))
    ),
    fluidRow(
      column(
        4,
        numericInput("r_sdfr", "Short Delay Free row:", value = 7, min = 1)
      ),
      column(
        4,
        numericInput("r_ldfr", "Long Delay Free row:", value = 8, min = 1)
      ),
      column(
        4,
        numericInput("r_ldcr", "Long Delay Cued row:", value = 9, min = 1)
      )
    ),
    fluidRow(
      column(3, numericInput("r_hits", "Total Hits row:", value = 11, min = 1)),
      column(
        3,
        numericInput("r_fp", "False Positives row:", value = 12, min = 1)
      ),
      column(3, numericInput("r_dprime", "d' row:", value = 13, min = 1)),
      column(
        3,
        numericInput("r_nonpar", "Nonparametric row:", value = 14, min = 1)
      )
    ),
    fluidRow(
      column(
        6,
        numericInput("r_intrus", "Intrusions row:", value = 16, min = 1)
      ),
      column(6, numericInput("r_fc", "Forced-Choice row:", value = 18, min = 1))
    ),

    hr(),
    h4("Index Page (Trials 1-4 Correct standard score)"),
    fluidRow(
      column(
        4,
        selectInput(
          "idx_col_raw",
          "Sum Scaled Col:",
          choices = idx_cols,
          selected = idx_cols[min(2, length(idx_cols))]
        )
      ),
      column(
        4,
        selectInput(
          "idx_col_score",
          "Index Score Col:",
          choices = idx_cols,
          selected = idx_cols[min(3, length(idx_cols))]
        )
      ),
      column(
        4,
        selectInput(
          "idx_col_pct",
          "Percentile Col:",
          choices = idx_cols,
          selected = idx_cols[min(4, length(idx_cols))]
        )
      )
    ),
    numericInput("r_trials14", "Trials 1-4 row:", value = 2, min = 1),

    hr(),
    h4("Process Page (Repetitions)"),
    fluidRow(
      column(
        4,
        selectInput(
          "proc_col_raw",
          "Raw Col:",
          choices = proc_cols,
          selected = proc_cols[min(2, length(proc_cols))]
        )
      ),
      column(
        4,
        selectInput(
          "proc_col_score",
          "Scaled Col:",
          choices = proc_cols,
          selected = proc_cols[min(3, length(proc_cols))]
        )
      ),
      column(
        4,
        selectInput(
          "proc_col_pct",
          "Percentile Col:",
          choices = proc_cols,
          selected = proc_cols[min(4, length(proc_cols))]
        )
      )
    ),
    numericInput("r_rep", "Repetitions row:", value = 5, min = 1)
  )
})

# Build final data
observeEvent(input$build_btn, {
  req(rv$core)

  core <- rv$core
  idx <- rv$index
  proc <- rv$process

  get_val <- function(df, row, col) {
    if (is.null(df) || row > nrow(df) || !col %in% names(df)) {
      return(NA)
    }
    safe_num(df[[col]][row])
  }

  results <- tibble(
    scale = c(
      "Trial 1 Correct",
      "Trial 2 Correct",
      "Trial 3 Correct",
      "Trial 4 Correct",
      "Trials 1-4 Correct",
      "Short Delay Free Recall",
      "Long Delay Free Recall",
      "Long Delay Cued Recall",
      "Total Hits",
      "Total False Positives",
      "Recognition Discriminability (d')",
      "Recognition Discriminability Nonparametric",
      "CVLT-3 Total Intrusions",
      "CVLT-3 Total Repetitions",
      "CVLT-3 Forced-Choice Recognition Hits"
    ),
    raw_score = c(
      get_val(core, input$r_t1, input$col_raw),
      get_val(core, input$r_t2, input$col_raw),
      get_val(core, input$r_t3, input$col_raw),
      get_val(core, input$r_t4, input$col_raw),
      get_val(idx, input$r_trials14, input$idx_col_raw),
      get_val(core, input$r_sdfr, input$col_raw),
      get_val(core, input$r_ldfr, input$col_raw),
      get_val(core, input$r_ldcr, input$col_raw),
      get_val(core, input$r_hits, input$col_raw),
      get_val(core, input$r_fp, input$col_raw),
      get_val(core, input$r_dprime, input$col_raw),
      get_val(core, input$r_nonpar, input$col_raw),
      get_val(core, input$r_intrus, input$col_raw),
      get_val(proc, input$r_rep, input$proc_col_raw),
      get_val(core, input$r_fc, input$col_raw)
    ),
    score = c(
      get_val(core, input$r_t1, input$col_score),
      get_val(core, input$r_t2, input$col_score),
      get_val(core, input$r_t3, input$col_score),
      get_val(core, input$r_t4, input$col_score),
      get_val(idx, input$r_trials14, input$idx_col_score),
      get_val(core, input$r_sdfr, input$col_score),
      get_val(core, input$r_ldfr, input$col_score),
      get_val(core, input$r_ldcr, input$col_score),
      get_val(core, input$r_hits, input$col_score),
      get_val(core, input$r_fp, input$col_score),
      get_val(core, input$r_dprime, input$col_score),
      get_val(core, input$r_nonpar, input$col_score),
      get_val(core, input$r_intrus, input$col_score),
      get_val(proc, input$r_rep, input$proc_col_score),
      NA # Forced-choice has no scaled score
    ),
    percentile = c(
      get_val(core, input$r_t1, input$col_pct),
      get_val(core, input$r_t2, input$col_pct),
      get_val(core, input$r_t3, input$col_pct),
      get_val(core, input$r_t4, input$col_pct),
      get_val(idx, input$r_trials14, input$idx_col_pct),
      get_val(core, input$r_sdfr, input$col_pct),
      get_val(core, input$r_ldfr, input$col_pct),
      get_val(core, input$r_ldcr, input$col_pct),
      get_val(core, input$r_hits, input$col_pct),
      get_val(core, input$r_fp, input$col_pct),
      get_val(core, input$r_dprime, input$col_pct),
      get_val(core, input$r_nonpar, input$col_pct),
      get_val(core, input$r_intrus, input$col_pct),
      get_val(proc, input$r_rep, input$proc_col_pct),
      50 # Forced-choice default
    )
  )

  # Join metadata
  final <- results |>
    left_join(meta, by = "scale") |>
    mutate(
      test = "cvlt3_brief",
      test_name = "CVLT-3 Brief",
      ci_95 = NA_character_,
      range = NA_character_
    )

  # Apply ranges
  if (
    neuro2_available &&
      exists("gpluck_make_score_ranges", where = asNamespace("neuro2"))
  ) {
    final <- neuro2::gpluck_make_score_ranges(final, test_type = "npsych_test")
  }

  final <- final |>
    mutate(
      result = ifelse(
        !is.na(description) & !is.na(range),
        paste0(description, " was ", range, "."),
        NA_character_
      )
    ) |>
    select(any_of(col_order))

  rv$final <- final
  showNotification(paste("Built", nrow(final), "scales"), type = "message")
})

output$final_tbl <- renderDT({
  req(rv$final)
  datatable(
    rv$final,
    options = list(scrollX = TRUE, pageLength = 20),
    rownames = FALSE
  )
})

output$dl <- downloadHandler(
  filename = function() paste0("cvlt3_brief_", Sys.Date(), ".csv"),
  content = function(file) {
    write.csv(
      rv$final %||% data.frame(error = "No data"),
      file,
      row.names = FALSE,
      na = ""
    )
  }
)
```
